recommendations.title: Update the Payntra README to reflect the real SMTP/MTU root cause — yesterday's non-negotiable, now 2x the cost
recommendations.reason: The current Payntra README documents the SMTP blocker as 'outbound TLS handshake to mail.cyberslide.net:465/587 times out from dev VPS IP — use Resend/Postmark/SES' — but that's wrong. The real root cause was three-headed: (1) Docker bridge MTU 1500 fragmented TLS handshakes against host MTU 1400, (2) env_file: .env wasn't mounted into the app container so SMTP creds were empty, (3) db service wasn't on the same payntra-net as the app so the host `db` didn't resolve. ALL three are fixed in docker-compose.yml. The cost of skipping this just doubled: SYNTRA is shipping tonight with the EXACT same mail.cyberslide.net:587 + MTU 1400 + env_file stack, so a wrong README on Payntra will leak into SYNTRA's rollout. The next person (you in 3 months, or me on a re-invite) who hits 'SMTP not working' on either app will re-investigate the wrong hypothesis for hours — same as the Jul 5 402-message Payntra session did. Yesterday's non-negotiable didn't ship. Don't carry it into a 3rd morning brief.
recommendations.action: Open /root/.hermes/projects/syntra/ (the source folder has a replit.md but Payntra's actual README needs to be located — check the original payntra repo or wherever the deployment docs live). Find the 'SMTP Blocker' or 'Outbound Email' section. Replace the 'cloud VPS IP blocked, swap to Resend/Postmark/SES' guidance with the actual fix: (1) Docker bridge MTU forced to 1400 via driver_opts: com.docker.network.driver.mtu: '1400' in the payntra-net network, (2) env_file: .env mounted on BOTH app and db services, (3) db service attached to payntra-net so the `db` host resolves. Include the verification commands: docker exec payntra-app node -e 'nodemailer.createTransport(...).verify()' and curl -X POST https://payntra.terrybot.top/api/auth/forgot-password. Also re-run the Playwright e2e suite (npx playwright test) against the live build to confirm the SMTP/MTU fixes didn't regress. 20 minutes of work, gates all future Payntra + SYNTRA SMTP debugging from going down the wrong path.
